intro.text: Elliott Levine has spent two decades in real estate and business financing and is known for creative loan structuring that fits each client. Before Harvest, he was President and Founder of Stellar Capital Solutions, helping hundreds of clients own and operate their own businesses. Today he helps owners finance commercial real estate with SBA and conventional loans. Away from work he's a husband, dad of two, volunteer youth coach and local charity fundraiser.

items.d: Finance the purchase of owner-occupied commercial real estate: office, industrial or retail.
Refinance existing commercial property debt into a structure that fits your business.
Pull cash out of commercial property you own, or include working capital in an SBA 7(a) loan.

advantage.text: Harvest is a non-bank lender holding one of only 14 SBLC licenses issued by the SBA that allow non-banks to originate SBA 7(a) loans. It is consistently ranked among the top ten SBA 7(a) lenders nationwide and was named NADCO's 2026 Non-Bank 504 Lender of the Year for the third year in a row.

reviews.text: A quick review helps other business owners find the right lender.

faq: What kinds of loans does Elliott offer?
SBA 7(a), SBA 504 and conventional commercial real estate loans for purchase, refinance and cash-out.
No. Harvest is a non-bank lender licensed by the SBA to originate SBA 7(a) loans.
Which loan is right for me?
It depends on your property and plans. Elliott can walk you through the options for your business.
